vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained and unsafe by design

statements.impact_statement: Lightstack includes other x/crypto packages, but neither the source import graph nor the compiled binaries contain golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp or its subpackages.
statements.action_statement: Re-run govulncheck and review this statement whenever x/crypto or the production import graph changes.
